description: PNG asset structure and decompression-bomb vectors. Format v1 PNG: valid CRCs, only IHDR/PLTE/tRNS/IDAT/IEND, at most 4,096 by 4,096 and 16 million decoded pixels, at most 8 MiB (spec 0030). `code` is the full verdict; `structure`, when present, is the verdict of the header and chunk walk alone, which refuses every dimension bomb before inflation.

cases.name: tiny valid greyscale
cases.why: 1x1, one filter byte and one sample.

cases.name: 4000x4000 is exactly 16 million pixels
cases.why: At the pixel ceiling; zeros compress to a few KiB.

cases.name: no IDAT
cases.why: An image needs at least one IDAT chunk.

cases.name: 4096x4096 exceeds 16 million pixels
cases.why: 16,777,216 pixels: each side is legal, the product is not, so the header alone must refuse it.

cases.name: 2^31 width header bomb
cases.why: A 33-byte header claiming 4.6e18 pixels: refused before any allocation.

cases.name: inflate bomb
cases.why: 1x1 image whose IDAT inflates to 10 MiB; a decoder must stop at height*(1+width) = 2 bytes.

cases.name: text chunk not allowed
cases.why: Only IHDR, PLTE, tRNS, IDAT and IEND are permitted.

cases.name: zTXt compressed text bomb carrier
cases.why: A compressed text chunk is a second inflation surface; it is refused by type.

cases.name: chunk length past end
cases.why: A length field larger than the file must not be trusted for allocation.
